Salesforce is an AI CRM and cloud computing company focused on helping organizations drive customer success through trusted, scalable technology. The Software Engineering AMTS will join a year-long graduate program to architect, design, implement, test, and deliver scalable products while collaborating with engineering, product, UX, and performance teams. The role also involves developing test strategies, automation frameworks, and automated test suites across Salesforce applications and platforms.
